story.text: 아침부터 날씨가 흐렸다. 창문을 열자 서늘한 바람이 훅 들어왔다.
story.reading: a-chim-bu-teo nal-ssi-ga heu-ryeot-da. chang-mun-eul yeol-ja seo-neul-han ba-ram-i huk deul-eo-wat-da.
story.en: The weather was overcast from the morning. When I opened the window, a cool breeze rushed in.

story.text: '오늘 날씨 좀 봐봐.' 하늘이 휴대폰 화면을 내밀었다. 일교차가 크다는 예보였다.
story.reading: 'o-neul nal-ssi jom bwa-bwa.' ha-neul-i hyu-dae-pon hwa-myeon-eul nae-mil-eot-da. il-gyo-cha-ga keu-da-neun ye-bo-yeot-da.
story.en: "Check today's weather." Haneul held out his phone screen. The forecast said the temperature gap would be big.

story.text: '반팔만 입고 나가지 마. 아침엔 꽤 추워.' 그가 툭 내뱉듯 말했다.
story.reading: 'ban-pal-man ip-go na-ga-ji ma. a-chim-en kkwae chu-wo.' geu-ga tuk nae-baet-deut mal-haet-da.
story.en: "Don't go out in just short sleeves. It's pretty cold in the morning." He said it bluntly.

story.text: '낮에는 또 덥다던데.' 내가 중얼거리자, 하늘은 얇은 겉옷 하나를 내 손에 쥐여줬다. '벗었다 입었다 해.'
story.reading: 'naj-e-neun tto deop-da-deon-de.' nae-ga jung-eol-geo-ri-ja, ha-neul-eun yalb-eun geot-ot ha-na-reul nae son-e jwi-yeo-jwot-da. 'beos-eot-da ib-eot-da hae.'
story.en: "But I heard it'll get hot in the afternoon." I muttered, and Haneul pressed a light jacket into my hand. "Just take it off and put it back on as needed."

story.text: '비도 온대. 우산 챙겼어?' 그가 물었다. 나는 가방 속 접이식 우산을 흔들어 보였다.
story.reading: 'bi-do on-dae. u-san chaeng-gyeoss-eo?' geu-ga mul-eot-da. na-neun ga-bang sok jeob-i-sik u-san-eul heun-deul-eo bo-yeot-da.
story.en: "They say it might rain too. Did you bring an umbrella?" he asked. I showed him the folding umbrella tucked in my bag.

story.text: '오늘 옷차림 그거면 됐어. 나쁘지 않네.' 그가 내 위아래를 한 번 훑고는 짧게 평가했다.
story.reading: 'o-neul ot-cha-rim geu-geo-myeon dwaess-eo. na-ppeu-ji anh-ne.' geu-ga nae wi-a-rae-reul han beon hult-go-neun jjalb-ge pyeong-ga-haet-da.
story.en: "That outfit works for today. Not bad." He gave me a quick once-over and delivered his brief verdict.

story.text: 무심한 말투였지만, 나는 왠지 웃음이 났다. 오늘도 날씨보다 이 사람 챙김이 더 든든했다.
story.reading: mu-sim-han mal-tu-yeot-ji-man, na-neun waen-ji us-eum-i nat-da. o-neul-do nal-ssi-bo-da i sa-ram chaeng-gim-i deo deun-deun-haet-da.
story.en: His tone was indifferent as ever, but somehow it made me smile. Today, too, his care felt more reassuring than the weather report.

words.example_en: It'll get hot in the afternoon.
